Hi Olivia / Jason —

Thanks again for the demo today — good questions from your ML infra and procurement teams. As promised, attached is a first-draft commitment trajectory (MAP) that aligns the evaluation sprint with procurement milestones and the path to a marketplace private offer on AWS/Azure/GCP. High-level plan here: 

- Week 1–2: Staged eval (P0 perf tests + latency SLO verification) — redwood-hosted sandbox.
- Week 3: Procurement kickoff (PO template review, billing owner identified).
- Week 4–6: Marketplace private-offer setup (PO submission to chosen cloud marketplace, billing routing test).
- Week 7: Production canary on Dedicated capacity; finalize SLA and support addendum.

Two immediate asks: 1) Confirm which cloud marketplace you prefer to close through (AWS Private Offer / Azure Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) and 2) Please share the name/email of the procurement contact who will handle the contract/billing lane.

I attached an editable MAP spreadsheet (Redwood_MAP_StratusAI_v1.xlsx) with milestone owners and acceptance criteria. I also included a short evaluation checklist (evaluation-checklist-v1.pdf) for your infra team to run the P0 tests.

If you’re good, I’ll schedule a 30-min alignment call with your procurement and our finance/partnerships lead (Aditya).

Thanks,

Thanks Olivia — adding Maria, and I’ve updated the MAP to note GCP as your preferred lane with AWS as a fallback. See the attached spreadsheet for owner assignments and acceptance criteria. Quick answers to your perf questions below: 

- Baseline target (GPT-style family, 2k context): 75–120 tokens/sec sustained for batched inference; 95th p50 latency <= 220ms for single-stream QPS 5.
- For heavy-dialog variants (longer context): expect lower throughput (25–45 tokens/sec); we recommend Dedicated pool for sustained load.
- We’ll provide a benchmarking script + a Jupyter notebook example in the Drive link (see related_links).

Next steps I propose (short checklist):
1) Procurement: Maria to confirm billing entity and provide billing contact.
2) Legal: quick marketplace contract review (Aditya to own + link to DocuSign template).
3) Infra eval: Jason to run perf checklist and report results back in 5 business days.
4) Marketplace setup: Redwood to provision required partner/offer metadata for GCP private offer; parallel AWS PO prep if needed.

I’ll schedule the call for Fri at 10:30 PT unless you want a different time.

Neha
